Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

2.1 A deviation of ±2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

2.2 The mass of the forceps shall be 250 ± 10 _g. 

3, Materials — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 of 13:6603-1972 * Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats '. 



Adopted 21 June 1979 




INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION

18:9184-1979 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4'1 The forceps shall be free from cracks, seams, fiaws and other surface defects. 

4.2 Each arm of the forceps shall be forged in one piece. 

4-3 The forceps shall be made right sided or left sided as required by the purchaser. 

4.4 All edges shall be well rounded and finished smooth. 

4.5 The forceps shall be polished bright and passivated. 

5. Heat Treatment — The forceps shall be hardened and tempered to give a hardness of 370 
to 430 HV. 

6. Test 

6.1 Corrosion Resistance — Test the forceps in accordance with IS : 7531-1975 ' Method for boiling 
and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments'. After the test, 
the forceps shall show no sign of corrosion, 

7. Marking — The forceps shall be marked with the manufacturer's name, initials or recognized 
trade-mark. 

7.1 iSI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
